item.description:
H-LOG 2026.08.11 [EN]

H-LOG: Professionals Report

the futures session

  • the cash session (Spot): The cash market is currently closed. Despite the NDX Star decreasing by (-0.34%), strong accumulation was recorded on the cash market with cumulative energy flow (CVD) at 54.69 M, suggesting passive absorption of supply at lower price levels.
  • Futures and broad market: the NQ Probe shows slight stabilization (+0.02%) with almost neutral energy flow (-1,02 K), which, given the extremely low Background Radiation (TICKQ) reading (-323.00 relative to the SMA200 average of 116.39), indicates high selling pressure in the broad market after the close of the regular session.
  • Sentiment and flows: The aggregate flow direction index is 10, which on a scale of -100 to +100 means very weak, almost neutral sentiment with a slight inflow advantage, which contradicts the negative dynamics of the broad market.
  • QQQ options analysis: The options market shows moderate implied volatility (IV: 20.60%) with a Put/Call Ratio at 0.97, suggesting a close balance between hedges and long positions. The market-expected range of movement for the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) lies within the 714.04 – 727.70 range.
